# The flags `zarf init` accepts, including the global flags it inherits, recorded from the zarf
# documentation for the release this wrapper was written against.
#
# Source: https://docs.zarf.dev/commands/zarf_init/
# Recorded: 2026-10-02
#
# TestInitArgsAreKnownFlags holds every flag the module renders against this list. It cannot prove
# the list still matches the installed zarf -- the wrapper runs zarf as a child process and has no
# command tree to read -- so refresh it from `zarf init --help` when the pinned zarf moves, and the
# test will name any flag that went away.
#
# One flag per line. Blank lines and lines beginning with # are ignored.
